Hello ladies,

I realize that most of you reading this are just lurkers and don't want to contribute due to the vitriol we have faced recently but I want to keep all of our sisters updated on the latest news.

As many of you already know I have a monthly meeting with other local rational feminists to share stories, vent about our most recent oppressions, and discuss issues (as our online presence grows we will be planning a larger meetup by the way). We intentionally scheduled this months meeting for yesterday to boycott 'Valentine's Day.' Here is what I'm hearing:

Rational feminism is growing!!! We've all seen a greater interest recently as more and more women seek safe harbor away from the patriarchy, modern radical feminism, and the social justice cult. We even had two new woman in attendance last night who wanted more information and both expressed interest in coming to next months meeting!

This is fabulous news. Our grassroots effort is working and we must continue to spread awareness and educate. Remember to be civil and answer questions. The biggest cause that seems to be driving so many to flee modern radical feminism and the social justice cult is their habit of participating in shouting matches and name calling, threats, witch hunts, isolating any opinion that strays from the hivemind, and sticking their fingers in their ears when they hear an opinion they don't like. We don't participate in any of this. Our job is to educate not judge and we want to encourage open dialogue and debate. We don't need to shout or force our beliefs on others we are on the right side of history and women will continue to flock to us voluntarily as they become more aware of our movement.

Due to our recent growth we have been discussing some new ideas. One is that I'm going to try to give at least a monthly update regarding the latest news in rational feminism in conjunction with our usual conversations.

Another idea that was suggested last night was creating some merchandise related to rational feminism. Tshirts, coffee mugs, bumper stickers, and the like to both spread awareness and to show our pride as rational feminists. I will be looking into this and will post mockups to get feedback before having them produced.

If anyone else has any ideas they would like to share please feel free to post here or contact me through PM.

Today is a day for celebration! We have seen one of the largest months of growth for our movement. Be proud of yourselves!
